package bodycodegen
namespace bodycodegen

entity Text id "bodycodegen://entity/text"

activity NormalizeText(Text) -> Text computes "let normalized = input\nnormalized = input\nlet accepted = normalized == \"approved\"\nif accepted { return \"allow\" } else { return \"deny\" }"

package joins
namespace joins
entity Integer id "joins://integer"
entity Boolean id "joins://boolean"
entity Text id "joins://text"

activity Left(Integer) -> Integer computes `let a = input - 1
let b = a - 3
return b - 9` assembling {
    choice "first" operand_order at "0" intent "첫 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the first operands."
    choice "second" operand_order at "1" intent "두 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the second operands."
    choice "third" operand_order at "2" intent "세 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the third operands."
    case "-8" -> "15"
    case "-1" -> "8"
    case "0" -> "7"
    case "3" -> "4"
    case "4" -> "3"
    case "9" -> "-2"
    attempts "8"
}
activity Right(Integer) -> Integer computes "return input * 2"
activity Add(Integer, Integer) -> Integer computes "return input0 + input1"
activity Difference(Integer, Integer) -> Integer computes "return input0 - input1"
activity Label(Integer, Boolean, Text) -> Text computes `if input1 && input0 > 0 { return input2 + "!" } else { return input2 }`
activity Compare(Text, Text) -> Boolean computes "return input0 == input1"
activity Invert(Boolean) -> Boolean computes "return !input"

bind Left.result -> Add.input0
bind Right.result -> Add.input1
bind Right.result -> Difference.input0
bind Left.result -> Difference.input1
bind Add.result -> Label.input0
bind Compare.result -> Invert.input

package records
namespace records
entity Integer id "records://integer"
entity Boolean id "records://boolean"
entity Text id "records://text"
entity Candidate id "records://candidate" fields {
    field title id "records://candidate/title" type string required one
    field state id "records://candidate/state" type string required one
}
entity Review id "records://review" fields {
    field summary id "records://review/summary" type string required one
    field reason id "records://review/reason" type string required one
}

activity Score(Integer) -> Integer computes `let a = input - 1
let b = a - 3
return b - 9` assembling {
    choice "first" operand_order at "0" intent "첫 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the first operands."
    choice "second" operand_order at "1" intent "두 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the second operands."
    choice "third" operand_order at "2" intent "세 번째 피연산자를 반대로 배치한다. Reverse the third operands."
    case "-8" -> "15"
    case "-1" -> "8"
    case "0" -> "7"
    case "3" -> "4"
    case "4" -> "3"
    case "9" -> "-2"
    attempts "8"
}
activity Propose(Integer, Text) -> Candidate computes `if input0 >= 0 { return Candidate{title: input1, state: "ready"} } else { return Candidate{title: input1, state: "wait"} }`
activity ReviewCandidate(Candidate, Boolean) -> Review computes `if input1 && input0.state == "ready" { return Review{summary: input0.title, reason: "accepted"} } else { return Review{summary: input0.title, reason: "deferred"} }`
activity Label(Review) -> Text computes `let copy = input
return copy.summary + ":" + copy.reason`
activity Echo(Candidate) -> Candidate computes "return input"
activity Same(Candidate, Candidate) -> Boolean computes "return input0 == input1"

bind Score.result -> Propose.input0
bind Propose.result -> ReviewCandidate.input0
bind ReviewCandidate.result -> Label.input
bind Propose.result -> Echo.input
bind Echo.result -> Same.input0
bind Propose.result -> Same.input1

package source_ir_fill_derived
namespace source_ir_fill_derived
entity Integer id "source-ir-fill-derived://integer"

activity Lift(Integer) -> Integer computes `let base = __GOOO_BODY_HOLE_seed__
let increment = __GOOO_BODY_HOLE_step__
return base + increment` assembling {
    source_fill intent "Represent input plus one as a base value and a small increment." {
        hole "seed"
        hole "step"
        derive grammar "integer-offset-constant/v1" max_expressions "8" max_candidates "16"
    }
    case "-2" -> "-1"
    case "0" -> "1"
    case "7" -> "8"
}

package bodycodegen
namespace bodycodegen

entity Integer id "bodycodegen://entity/integer"

activity ClampNegativeToZero(Integer) -> Integer computes "let output = input; if input < 0 { output = __GOOO_BODY_HOLE_floor__ } else { output = input }; return output" assembling {
    search hole "floor" grammar "integer-offset-constant/v1" intent "Return zero for negative integers and preserve zero or positive integers." max_candidates "16"
    case "-2" -> "0"
    case "-1" -> "0"
    case "0" -> "0"
    case "1" -> "1"
    case "2" -> "2"
    holdout_case "-9223372036854775808" -> "0"
    holdout_case "9223372036854775807" -> "9223372036854775807"
    attempts "8"
}

package source_assembly
namespace source_assembly
entity Integer id "source-assembly://integer"

activity Qualified(Integer) -> Integer computes `let first = input + 2
let second = input * 2
let chosen = first
let eligible = input >= 0 && input != 2
if eligible && !(input > 4) {
    chosen = chosen + 3
} else {
    chosen = chosen - 3
}
return chosen + (first + second)` assembling {
    choice "base-local" local_reference at "0" alternative "second" intent "두 번째 지역값을 분기의 기준으로 사용한다. Use the second local as the branch base."
    choice "condition-branches" branch_layout at "0" intent "0 이상 2가 아닌 값이 4 이하이면 3을 더하고 나머지는 3을 뺀다. Add three for eligible values through four, otherwise subtract three."
    choice "independent-declarations" root_order at "0" intent "두 값은 독립이므로 선언 순서는 어느 쪽이든 된다. Either independent declaration order is valid."
    case "-1" -> "-6"
    case "0" -> "5"
    case "2" -> "9"
    case "4" -> "25"
    case "5" -> "24"
    attempts "8"
}

activity Clamp(Integer) -> Integer computes "if input < 0 { return 0 } else if input < 10 { return input } else { return 10 }" assembling {
    choice "lower-branch" branch_layout at "0" intent "음수이면 0을 반환한다. Return zero for negative input."
    choice "upper-comparison" operand_order at "1" intent "입력이 10보다 작은지 확인한다. Check input below ten."
    choice "middle-branch" branch_layout at "1" intent "중간 범위는 입력을, 그 이상은 10을 반환한다. Return input in the middle range, otherwise ten."
    case "-1" -> "0"
    case "5" -> "5"
    case "11" -> "10"
    attempts "8"
}
